scope: Unlit CPU orthographic comparison on exact actual remastered base e1m1 face UVs. Three colour trial PNG substitutions only; all other available textures use unchanged current catalog diffuse, else unchanged native fallback. No light/height/GPU/runtime/publication/8x/owner acceptance.
sampling: Each 4x output pixel samples its world-space centre. Actual per-face UV maps native texels to decoded source dimensions with periodic nearest sampling. Convex coverage uses every polygon edge and summed polygon normal, retaining collinear T-junctions. For each variant BOTH world/2 and world/4 are BOX reductions of its own4x composition; display sheets then use labelled nearest enlargement. Native4x sampling replicates unchanged native pixels.
